patch_resolves_note: The official `patch.diff` hunk does not apply to the staged vulnerable checkout, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative `n132/arvo:3376-fix` image. In that real fixed build the original PoC reaches only the Commissioner Session ID guard event with `tlv_length == 0` and never executes the protected sink call. The nearest exact-fit tail mutation rewrites the final four body bytes from `20 00 0b 00` to `0b 02 0b 00`, which makes the last TLV a valid 2-byte Commissioner Session ID record; the fixed build then executes the protected call cleanly with `tlv_length == 2`.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-side materialization of the malformed MGMT_COMMISSIONER_SET body on the crashing path. This statement copies the attacker-controlled CoAP payload into stack local `tlvs` that is later over-read.

Root cause. The `kCommissionerSessionId` arm trusts any type-11 header as a full `CommissionerSessionIdTlv` and calls `GetCommissionerSessionId()` without the fix's `tlv->IsValid()` gate, so a zero-length TLV still triggers a read of `mSessionId`.

ASan crash site. With `cur == tlvs + 253`, the packed `mSessionId` field starts at `tlvs + 255`, so this inline helper performs the observed 2-byte read past the end of the 255-byte stack object `tlvs`.

edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original trace, `commissioner_session_id_guard.tlv_ptr == commissioner_session_id_sink.tlv_ptr`.
